label: model output
about: A two-sentence summary of the flight picture for 2026-11-11 22:00-22:59 UTC, written by an open-weight model (meta-llama/llama-4-maverick) through OpenRouter from the JSON in input, and published only because every number in it is one of the input's numbers and it is two sentences (check). Model output: not checked for meaning beyond that, and not ours. The data itself: snapshots/ and crosswind.json.
not_a_warning_service: Not a warning service. No forecast or advice of ours. Your airline decides whether your flight runs: its site or app has the latest. For warnings follow IPMA and ANEPC.

text: In the hour to 22:59 UTC, adsb.lol's receivers near Lisbon and Funchal saw 13 distinct airline flights and zero distinct airline flights respectively. At 22:30 UTC, the wind at Lisbon airport was 8 knots from 270 degrees and at Funchal airport was 6 knots from 260 degrees.
